idea: Six bare, mid-remodel bathroom zones of a 1994 Beaverton two-story contemporary (primary vanity wall, powder room, shower wall, tub alcove, guest vanity, water-closet nook) turn into six different built-ins from six camera angles in six autumn light moments.
